description: This file contains implementation of functions related to the 'Ping' diagnostic tool for a broadband management system. Specifically, it includes the function 'BbhmDiagResolvAddr', which performs address resolution using getaddrinfo, setting up socket address info for IPv4 and IPv6, and handling related socket setup tasks.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagResolvAddr(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resolves the destination address for the ping operation, sets up socket address info, and configures the socket protocol based on the resolved address family.
